startHere: This is the shared world. Start here: Café for birds.
describe: Describe a place, object, or continuation in a short phrase.
suggestions: A bus stop for the café's regulars.
unsupported: This idea isn’t supported yet. Try describing something the world can hold.
privatePreview: Private preview — only you can see this.
understood: Here’s how the world understood your idea.
couldNotPlace: We couldn’t place this yet. Your draft is saved — try a supported idea.
publishQuestion: Publish this to the shared world?
publishExplain: Once published, other people can see it and continue it. You’ll be credited as its author.
published: Published. It’s part of the shared world.
lookWithoutAccount: You can look around and try an idea without an account.
sinceLast: Since you were last here: {name} continued your {creation}.
nothingNew: Nothing new has been published here.
inviteRequired: An invitation is required before publishing.
inviteRefused: That invitation could not be used.
pii: Don't include personal data such as an email or a phone number.
controls: That phrase contains characters the world cannot keep.
fingerprintMismatch: That confirmation no longer matches. Review the preview and confirm again.
recoveryRefused: That recovery code could not be used.
superseded: A newer preview replaced that one.
needsIdentity: Choose a pseudonym to publish. No email is asked.
recoveryWarning: This recovery code is shown once. If you lose access and this code, this identity cannot be recovered.
iUnderstand: I understand. I have saved the code.
conflict: The world changed. Review the refreshed preview, then confirm again.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait and try again.
paused: New previews are paused. Already prepared ideas can still be published.
loadFailed: The world could not be loaded.
origin: This page address cannot change the world. Open localhost or 127.0.0.1 on this server's port.
illustrationUnavailable: Illustration unavailable. The list still works.
illustrationLoading: The illustration is loading. The list already works.
emptyWorld: This world has no places yet.
offline: You appear to be offline. Nothing was published.
expired: This preview expired. Your sentence is kept until it is purged.
clarification: The world needs a clearer phrase.
noChange: That phrase does not change the world.
contextLost: The illustration stopped. Reload it, or keep using the list.
